# SheetJS distribution

Official SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, downloaded from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz. Included for reproducible npm installation. The public npm registry xlsx package is outdated. License: Apache-2.0; the original license and notices are inside the tarball.
